messages:
Maya: Quick proposal — add an opaque routing hop/override header so the gateway can preempt routes when a tenant's dedicated pool hits burst or CB thresholds. Keep it client‑agnostic and small.

Raj: Can you sketch the header and its semantics? e.g. `X-Rd-Route-Override: backup=redwood-small-v2;reason=quota` ?

Maya: Yeah, something like:
```
X-Rd-Route-Override: backup=redwood-small-v2;ttl=30s;priority=low
```
Idea: gateway sets this when it decides to route to a cheaper/compatible backup model. Backend reads it to avoid client retries and to annotate traces.

Alex: Two concerns: 1) this could hide primary CB signals from product teams if not surfaced in Console, and 2) potential billing double-count if we allow downstream retries. We need telemetry and billing flags.

Maya: Totally. Plan: emit `route.override.fired` metric with tags `{tenant, route, backup_model, reason}` and a trace span `override_chain` that shows each hop. Also set `X-Rd-Override-Trace` header with a short id.

Sara: Regarding retries/billing — backends should treat override flows as terminal for the request: gateway will not re-enqueue to primary. Add a billing tag `override=true` so cost shows on tenant usage but attributed to the original request path (no duplicate charge).

Raj: Implementation note: gateway should attach `X-Rd-Override:true` + `X-Rd-Override-Trace:<id>` so downstream can short-circuit any internal retry logic. Also add a per-tenant opt-out flag.

infra-bot: deploy queued — canary to gateway-prod-1 at 2027-02-15T10:12Z :rocket:

Maya: Console UX: show a per-route "Fallback rate" panel (rate and pct of requests where override fired), and expose per-tenant toggles for `override.enabled` and `override.priority`. Also an explain tooltip listing last 24h reasons.

Alex: Rollout plan — default off. Feature flag gate, then tenant opt-in for Dedicated, and a gradual ramp with A/B via rollout API. Add alerts if fallback rate > 5% for 30m.

Sara: Circuit-breaker interaction: if primary CB trips, the backup must not be immediately saturated. Add a spillback window and a cooldown multiplier on backup's concurrency for N minutes. We'll need a probe policy that warms up backup lanes.

Maya: POC branch up as PR #4921 (WIP). Design doc will include metrics, trace screenshots, and example header semantics: https://redwood.internal/designs/route-override (posting shortly).

ops-oncall: ack — I will monitor `route.override.fired`, `backend.saturation`, and `fallback_rate` during the canary. Please add dashboard tiles and an alert runbook.

Raj: LGTM, I'll drop some comments on the PR about opt-out scope and tenant telemetry schema.

Maya: Thanks — will follow up with the design doc and a minimal schema for metrics/traces. :thumbsup:
